title: Downloads contain only the shown columns in screen order, honor all filters, and include the tab's Totals row
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. The report is open with a non-default column selection (for example, Inv. Hrs on and Advisor off), a chosen date range and location, and an advisor/customer/asset filter applied that hides some rows.
custom_steps:
1. Download the current tab as a CSV and open it.
2. Compare its columns to the screen's visible columns and order.
3. Compare its rows to the jobs left visible by the filters.
4. Compare its Totals row to the on-screen Totals row.
5. Repeat the same checks in the PDF.
custom_expected:
1. Both downloads include only the columns currently shown, in the same left-to-right order as the screen, with Total last.
2. Both downloads honor the current date range and location filter, and include only the jobs left visible by the advisor, customer, and asset filters.
3. Both downloads include a Totals row matching the on-screen Totals row for the tab.
